methodSections.heading: Avocado & Tomatillo Salsa
steps: Peel the outer leafy layer from the fresh tomatillos and then blanch them, whole, in boiling water for 1 minute. Drain the hot water and add them to a cold water bath for several minutes, to stop the cooking, before draining once more.
Remove the seed and skin from the ripe avocados and add to a blender along with all of the ingredients
Blend for 2 minutes. The ice is a neat trick to counter the heat generated from the spinning blades.
Pass through a strainer collecting the dressing in a bowl.
Serve with tostaditas or either of the following recipes.
